shortDescription: VALENCIA, Calif., Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Toll Brothers, Inc. NYSE:TOL, the nation's leading builder of luxury homes, today announced the final opportunity to purchase a new home in Toll Brothers at Tesoro Highlands - Alta Monte Collection, a gated luxury community in Valencia, Californi…

params.linkText: Toll Brothers at Tesoro Highlands - Alta Monte Collection

children: , a gated luxury community in Valencia, California. Only one home remains available for sale in the Alta Monte Collection of the community, located at 29924 North Camino Los Robles Lane in Santa Clarita.

image.alt: Toll Brothers at Tesoro Highlands - Alta Monte Collection

children: A stunning move-in ready Arpina home design, featuring 4,700+ square feet of living space, is available for sale in the community. Showcasing the ultimate luxury living, this home features expansive living spaces and modern finishes. This final home in the Alta Monte Collection is priced from $1.9 million.

image.alt: Toll Brothers at Tesoro Highlands - Alta Monte Collection

children: "This is the final chance for home shoppers to purchase a new home in this desirable community," said Nick Norvilas, Group President of Toll Brothers in Los Angeles. "With its exceptional design, breathtaking views, and convenient location near the best of Valencia, Toll Brothers at Tesoro Highlands truly exemplifies luxury living."

Toll Brothers at Tesoro Highlands features outstanding amenities including a clubhouse, gated entry, outdoor pool and spa, cabanas, outdoor grill areas, and a planned trail system for biking and hiking throughout Santa Clarita. Residents enjoy proximity to top-rated public and private schools, shopping and dining at the Valencia Town Center, and easy access to major freeways and transit systems connecting to Burbank, Hollywood, and Pasadena.

image.alt: Toll Brothers at Tesoro Highlands - Alta Monte Collection

children: For more information, contact Toll Brothers at 844-700-8655 or visit TollBrothers.com/CA.

Toll Brothers, Inc., a Fortune 500 Company, is the nation's leading builder of luxury homes. The Company was founded in 1967 and became a public company in 1986 with common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "TOL." Toll Brothers builds new homes and communities in over 60 markets across the United States, serving first-time, move-up, active-adult, and second-home buyers. The Company also operates its own architectural, engineering, mortgage, title, land development, smart home technology, landscape, and building components manufacturing businesses.

Toll Brothers was named the #1 Most Admired Home Builder in Fortune magazine's 2026 list of the World's Most Admired Companies®, the ninth year the Company has achieved this honor. Toll Brothers has also been named Builder of the Year by Builder magazine and is the first two-time recipient of Builder of the Year from Professional Builder magazine. For more information visit TollBrothers.com.
